article_published_complete.name: article_published_complete

article_in_review_complete.name: article_in_review_complete
article_in_review_complete.value: "article"."status" <> 'in_review' or ("article"."title" is not null and "article"."body_html" is not null and "article"."cover_url" is not null and "article"."submitted_at" is not null)
